Convex light-curve reconstruction with approximate thermal size: 166.69 km effective diameter (catalog ±2.77 km; additional shape and thermal-model uncertainty). The convex inversion resolves the broad shape; craters and concavities are unresolved. Other published pole solutions remain possible.
